items.title: Marshall Football Travels To ODU At 1 p.m. On Saturday
items.summary: Marshall Football hits the road for the first of two straight road contests on Saturday, traveling to Norfolk, Va., for a 1 p.m. matchup against Old Dominion at S.B. Ballard Stadium. The game will be shown on ESPN+ and is ODU's Homecoming for 2026.

items.title: Marshall Football’s Nov. 7 Game At Ga. Southern Set For 3:30 p.m.
items.summary: Marshall Football's Nov. 7 contest at Georgia Southern will be a 3:30 p.m. kickoff from Paulson Stadium in Statesboro, Ga., and shown on ESPN+, it was announced on Monday. The announcement at the 12-day window comes as part of the television contract between the Sun Belt Conference and ESPN.

items.title: Marshall Football Grinds Past South Alabama, 20-13
items.summary: Marshall running back Judah Price scored on a 4-yard run with 1:49 left in the game as the Thundering Herd earned a 20-13 victory over South Alabama in front of 21,904 fans and a national TV audience on Tuesday night.

items.title: Marshall Football’s Oct. 31 Game At ODU Set For 1 p.m.
items.summary: Marshall Football's Oct. 31 contest at Old Dominion will be a 1 p.m. kickoff shown on ESPN+ from S.B. Ballard Stadium in Norfolk, Va. The announcement was made in conjunction with the Sun Belt Conference and ESPN through the network's 12-day broadcast window.

items.title: Know Before You Go – South Alabama
items.summary: Here's all you need to Know Before You Go for Marshall Football's nationally-televised Sun Belt Conference showdown against South Alabama, which is set for 7:35 p.m. on Tuesday.

items.title: Marshall Football Hosts South Alabama At 7:30 p.m. On Tuesday
items.summary: Marshall Football takes part in a rare Tuesday night home game this week as South Alabama visits Joan C. Edwards Stadium for a 7:30 p.m. contest that will be shown nationally on ESPN2.

items.title: Marshall Football Falls To Coastal Carolina, 27-21
items.summary: Marshall Football dropped a 27-7 loss to Coastal Carolina in front of 23,029 fans at Joan C. Edwards Stadium on Saturday. With the loss, Marshall falls to 3-3 overall and 0-2 in Sun Belt Conference play.

items.title: Marshall Football Hosts Coastal Carolina At 7 p.m. On Saturday
items.summary: Marshall Football returns home under the lights on Saturday when Coastal Carolina comes to Joan C. Edwards Stadium for a 7 p.m. Sun Belt Conference matchup. The game serves as Marshall's annual 'We Are … Herd Strong' matchup and will be shown on ESPN+.

items.title: Know Before You Go – Coastal Carolina
items.summary: Saturday night. Under the lights. It's Gameday in Huntington. Marshall Football returns to Joan C. Edwards Stadium as the Thundering Herd welcomes Coastal Carolina for a 7 p.m. kickoff on Saturday. Here's everything Herd fans need to know before heading to The Joan.

items.title: Marshall Football Falls To JMU On Saturday
items.summary: Marshall quarterback Carlos Del Rio-Wilson threw for 221 yards, but it was not enough as the Thundering Herd fell to James Madison, 45-17, in front of 25,034 fans at Bridgeforth Stadium on Saturday afternoon.
